device_code.description: The device verification code used to poll for the access token.

user_code.description: The end-user verification code to enter on the authorization page.

verification_uri.description: The end-user verification URI on the authorization server.

verification_uri_complete.description: The verification URI that includes the user_code.

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the device_code and user_code.

interval.description: Minimum number of seconds between polling requests.
